title: Ad Copy Variation System
description: A structured way to develop and organise hook and headline variations for testing.

steps.label: Insight
steps.text: One customer insight and one motive per test.

steps.label: Variations
steps.text: AI generates hook and headline options within clear rules for tone and length.

steps.label: Selection
steps.text: The strongest, most honest options are chosen and refined.

steps.label: Library
steps.text: Variations are stored with motive, format and status – ready for the next campaign.

humanInLoop: No copy goes live without human selection and editing.
